cosmetic: The settings tab strip cuts off its edge labels (a lone 's' on the left, 'Projects' partly under the right chevron). The strip scrolls horizontally with chevron controls, so the tabs can still be reached.
In the dev-madrid card, the activity line wraps so that '11 minutes ago' sits alone on its own line.
The worktree summary line wraps, leaving a lone 'GB' on its own line in the dev-madrid and Browser member cards.

The disabled 'Open' button (dev-madrid) and 'Inspect worktrees' / 'Open' buttons (Offline fixture) have low contrast against the dark background. This fits their disabled state but makes them hard to read.
The helper text in the Native conversations card and the 'Coming later.' text are small and low-contrast, though still readable.
